lines.en: When the cherry petals fall, I follow.

lines.zh: 下面那片草地，开满小花了。
lines.en: That clearing below is full of little flowers.
Cherry petals fall; I drift with them.
My scales are dry; my wings steady out.
The cherry grove wind carries pink.
I read the petals; I won't get lost.

lines.zh: 这阵暖气流，正好托住我。
lines.en: This warm updraft holds me just right.
My wings are thin; one bump and I rest.
Lower, a little lower.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我认得回花丛的路。
lines.en: It's dark, but I know the way to my flowers.
Higher up is safer.

lines.zh: 我绕过树枝，去找那丛花。
lines.en: I'll skirt the branches and find that flower patch.

lines.zh: 慢慢扇，花瓣才追得上我。
lines.en: Beat slowly; the petals can keep up.
My wings are getting tired.

lines.zh: 樱花瓣打湿了，我飞得低。
lines.en: The cherry petals are damp; I fly low.

lines.zh: 我贴着花冠飞，不看下面。
lines.en: I hug the blossoms; I don't look down.

lines.zh: 樱花落在翅膀上，我不抖。
lines.en: Cherry petals land on my wings; I do not shake them off.
There's nectar on the wind, from the east.
When cherry petals fall, I drift with them.

lines.zh: 翅膀合上，我眯一小会儿。
lines.en: Wings folded, I'll doze just a moment.
There's still nectar on this petal.

lines.zh: 花瓣数到七，我就不数了。
lines.en: I counted seven petals and stopped.

lines.zh: 这里以前开着花，我记得。
lines.en: Flowers used to bloom here; I remember.

lines.zh: 停在花蕊上，我什么都不想。
lines.en: Resting on a stamen, thinking nothing.
Something's moving under the tree; so noisy.
Half a day of beating; my wing joints ache.
The sun's too bright; I'll hide in a blossom.
woods has this one perk.
Another two-legged thing.
Hold still. Let me see your flower.

lines.zh: 抬头找我也没用，我太小。
lines.en: Looking up won't help; I'm tiny.
There is cherry petal light behind you.

lines.zh: 樱花落下来，我顺着花瓣飞。
lines.en: Cherry petals fall, and I ride them down.
I count your steps, one by one.

lines.zh: 下面那个会走路的东西。
lines.en: That walking thing below.

lines.zh: 你这么大的，我见过，踩坏过花。
lines.en: I've seen your kind; you crush flowers.

lines.zh: 你站了半天，我一直在看。
lines.en: You've stood there a while; I've been watching.

lines.zh: 我翅上的粉，是樱花的颜色。
lines.en: The dust on my wings is cherry pink.
Stop chasing; I'm off to the flowers.
The wind in the cherry grove is pink.

lines.zh: 樱花落在翅膀上，蹭掉了粉。
lines.en: Cherry petals brushed the dust off my wings.

lines.zh: 我翅膀缺了一角，还能飞。
lines.en: A corner of my wing is gone; I can still fly.

lines.zh: 樱花落了一半，我也落了。
lines.en: Half the cherry petals fell, and so did I.
One pink wing, and one fall soils it.
A corner of my wing is gone; I fly crooked.
One twitch and my course is off.

lines.zh: 这笔账，我落在你肩上了。
lines.en: I'll settle this on your shoulder.
Easy — my wings are thinner than paper.

lines.zh: 手张开点，我怕你捏碎花蜜。
lines.en: Open your hand; don't crush the nectar.

lines.zh: 樱花林里，我停在花瓣上。
lines.en: In the cherry grove I rest on petals.

lines.zh: 甜的，是不是在你口袋里？
lines.en: Something sweet — is it in your pocket?

lines.zh: 樱花落在翅上，我不抖掉。
lines.en: Cherry petals on my wings. I leave them.

lines.zh: 就舔一下，一滴花蜜就好。
lines.en: Just one lick, one drop of nectar.
The nectar's sweet, so I fly slow.

lines.zh: 别收回去，让我再看看那颜色。
lines.en: Don't put it away, let me see the color again.
Cherry pollen dusts my wings.

lines.zh: 我用一片花瓣换你手里的。
lines.en: I'll trade a petal for what's in your hand.
My wingtips tremble — the cherry blossoms are too sweet.

lines.zh: 我撞在樱花瓣上，软软的。
lines.en: I bumped into a cherry petal — soft.
Steady now, two more beats will do.
Second time — you're harder than wind.

lines.zh: 我撞在花上，翅膀沾了粉。
lines.en: I hit a blossom and my wings got dusty.

lines.zh: 樱花瓣这么密，我绕不开。
lines.en: Petals so thick, I cannot get around.
Among the cherry trees, let me pass.

lines.zh: 天上我最灵巧，除了这次。
lines.en: I'm the nimblest up there — except this time.

lines.zh: 谁碰了我的翅膀！粉都掉了。
lines.en: Who touched my wing? My dust is falling!

lines.zh: 对不起，我的翅收得太晚。
lines.en: Sorry, I folded my wings too late.
Stop brushing against my petals.
Three circles, and I've chosen you.
I can only hum; bear with me.
Our nest of petals — let's go back to it.

lines.zh: 樱花落一层，我的巢就软一层。
lines.en: Each cherry petal softens my nest.

lines.zh: 我叼了只小虫，给你留着。
lines.en: I caught a small bug and kept it for you.
The pollen on your wings is lovely.

lines.zh: 最高的那枝，我留给咱俩。
lines.en: The highest branch — I saved it for us.

lines.zh: 那根枝够宽，你落我旁边。
lines.en: That branch is wide; land beside me.

lines.zh: 你的翅膀，比我见过的都白。
lines.en: Your wings are whiter than any I have seen.
The wind is from the east; fly with me.
This pads the nest; I'll take it.
A petal landed on my wing.
Pink petals make good nesting.

lines.zh: 这么粉的，得给同伴看看。
lines.en: So pink — my friends must see it.

lines.zh: 粉花瓣里蹲着，谁也看不见我。
lines.en: Among pink petals, nobody sees me.
Little thing — six legs are enough.
A gust tilted me; nearly fell.
I landed on this petal first; move.
So light; one hook of my wing lifts it.
How many now? I can still carry more.
The flowers are small; where will you hide?

lines.zh: 跑吧，我的影子先罩住你。
lines.en: Run — my shadow covers you first.
Cherry petals fall, and I fly with them.
A dive from the blossom is fastest.

lines.zh: 不扇了，我直接落你身上。
lines.en: No more beating; I'll drop right on you.

lines.zh: 你那么大，躲不过我的眼。
lines.en: You're so big; my eyes won't miss you.
You're right under the flower; saves me the search.

lines.zh: 我先扇两下翅膀，再扑过去。
lines.en: I beat my wings twice, then lunge.
Cherry petals settle on my wings — perfect.
Pink wings aimed at your face.
A few more steps and the flowers end.

lines.zh: 我贴着花瓣飞，你看不见。
lines.en: I fly along the petals; you can't see me.
I'm down to blossom height now.

lines.zh: 樱花落得慢，我飞得更慢。
lines.en: Cherry petals fall slow. I fly slower.
One turn of yours and my wings follow.
A tree ahead; you'll have to turn.

lines.zh: 粉色的翅，在樱林里看不清。
lines.en: Pink wings vanish among cherry blossoms.
Hold still a moment; let me see you.

lines.zh: 翅还软着，能陪你到天黑。
lines.en: My wings are fresh; I'll last till dark.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，花瓣跟着飞。
lines.en: I drop lower, petals trailing after me.

lines.zh: 樱花瓣落下来，抓到你了。
lines.en: Cherry petals fall — and I've got you.
A flutter, and I go for your eyes.
These flowers are mine; get down.
Don't underestimate small wings.
Taste this cherry thorn.
I rest on a cherry blossom.
I said I'd come down; I keep my word.
Six legs at once — that's plenty.
I've got your finger — don't shake me off.
One flap and your face is dusted.

lines.zh: 我从花瓣底下钻出来，翅膀还湿。
lines.en: I crawl out from under a petal, wings still damp.
Wings fresh and already this high — dizzy.

lines.zh: 这儿的空气，冻得翅发僵。
lines.en: The air here stiffens my wings.
I landed and the flowers aren't open yet.
They call me Cherry Rose Butterfly.
Good, the petal on my wing stayed.

lines.zh: 睁眼就在这棵樱树上，怪。
lines.en: I woke on this cherry tree — strange.

lines.zh: 有人叫我的名字，我来了。
lines.en: Someone called my name; I came.
My petals haven't opened yet.
Petals everywhere. Looks familiar.
The blossoms are burning — where do I land?
My wing's bent — I'm falling!
My wings are soaked; I sink straight down.

lines.zh: 樱花一落，我的翅膀也颤。
lines.en: When cherry petals fall, my wings quiver.
An arrow through my wing; I spin.
The spell got into my petals.

lines.zh: 没花蜜，我连翅都抬不起。
lines.en: No nectar; I can't even lift my wings.
The lightning dulled my pink.
No air current in the void; I fall.
